exact_predecessor: Provider retained original prepare commitment; recompute SHA-256(RFC8785(v2 original prepare with predecessor operation and supplied original destination)); equality to retained digest and request digest; exact key proof
admission: expired exact predecessor with complete retained history and established creator intent, no accepted or committed operation, no registered or revoked installation; one distinct successor atomically
identity: preserve creator intent, established association, opaque expected customer and original organization; new source admits fresh authenticated exact customer and current membership before any consent; no prior session reused
starter_policy: preserve predecessor source admission policy, no new offer or authority
replacement: one explicit fresh successor UUID; fresh-proof exact retry returns original still-eligible successor; competing successor conflicts
deadline: new fixed 600-second v2 source; no renewal or resurrection of predecessor; never extend root evidence retention

results.prepared: nonauthorizing original v2 prepare response and derived successor digest and intent only
results.accepted: original accepted operation UUID only, no successor; reconcile original owner
results.committed: original complete operation UUID only, existing v2 receipt and authenticated grant recovery retain authority; no new enrollment or grants

legacy_prepare: preserve exact live retry and independently unbound expired prepare behavior; no ordinary prepare bypass of retained creator-intent lineage
retention: minimum original prepare digest and source operation identity, creator/association and opaque actor commitment, organization, decision and successor identities; no expired locator, proof body, session or credential; original root creation plus at most 90 days; no replacement once evidence deleted
